questions.question: What does chapter 8 record?
options: A great census of all of the fighting men of Israel
The building of the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem
A severe famine that lasted for seven long years
David's military victories over surrounding nations
questions.answer: David's military victories over surrounding nations
